issues.evidence: Tibetan ཉེར་ལེན་སྲེད་པ is explained in bo-kunpal 9-46 as ཉེར་ལེན་ཏེ་ཉེ་བར་ལེན་པའི་རྒྱུ་སྲེད་པ, i.e. the craving that is the cause of grasping (upādāna); the bare Hindi compound can be read as 'grasping and craving' or an undefined compound.

issues.span: उसे शब्द ग्रहण से युक्त स्वभाव में नहीं देखा जाता है
issues.evidence: Tibetan དེ་ནི་སྒྲ་འཛིན་དང་ལྡན་པའི། རང་བཞིན་དུ་ནི་མཐོང་མ་ཡིན: the subject is the form-apprehender (གཟུགས་འཛིན་པ, bo-kunpal 9-64, bo-shenga 9-64) and it is 'not seen as having a nature endowed with sound-apprehension'. Hindi 'उसे ... स्वभाव में' leaves the referent unnamed and 'में' wrongly suggests location rather than 'as/of such a nature'.
issues.fix: वह (रूप-ग्राहक) शब्द-ग्रहण से युक्त स्वभाव वाला नहीं देखा जाता
